raydiance.configuration.title: Raydiance Settings
raydiance.configuration.materialSpecular: Sun highlights by material. Requires Direct DX12 and enabled integration.
Rain darkens and glosses upward, skylit surfaces. Does not simulate puddles.
raydiance.configuration.materialEmissive: Preserves classified emissive surface color in darkness. Does not light nearby blocks.
Water tint and opacity by depth. Requires native translucency; may increase cost.
raydiance.ui.scroll: Scroll or use arrow keys • line %s of %s
raydiance.ui.preview: Live preview. Save confirms; Cancel reverts.
raydiance.ui.hint: Hover for details • ? opens the guide
raydiance.ui.general: Change one option at a time and compare the same scene. Cost depends on resolution, GPU, pack and backend. Lower intensity does not always reduce samples or passes.
raydiance.ui.packGuide: These options and presets belong to this pack. Return to Shaderpacks and save to keep your changes.
raydiance.ui.presetTip: Previews this pack’s preset, including its visual settings, quality and FXAA.
raydiance.ui.resetTip: Resets every category in this pack and its general values, balanced quality and FXAA off. Save on the main screen to confirm.
raydiance.help.saturation: Color intensity. 0 removes color; 1 is neutral. Low cost in the color pass.
raydiance.help.contrast: Separates bright and dark tones. 1 is neutral; excess may hide shadow and cloud detail. Low cost.
raydiance.help.brightness: Multiplies image brightness. 1 is neutral. Compare against exposure before increasing it. Low cost.
raydiance.help.exposure: Overall exposure. 0 is neutral; positive values brighten the image. Watch bright surfaces for clipping. Low cost.
raydiance.help.gamma: Adjusts midtones. 1 is neutral. Use moderate values to preserve readable nights and caves. Low cost.
raydiance.help.temperature: Balances cool and warm colors. 0 is neutral. Combine carefully with pack-specific palette controls. Low cost.
raydiance.help.vignette: Darkens the edges of the image. 0 disables it. Strong values can reduce visibility near screen edges. Low cost.
raydiance.help.strength: Blends the post-processed result with the input. 0 removes this pass contribution. This does not disable Direct Terrain or all geometry effects.
raydiance.help.bloom: Spreads bright areas. 0 disables Raydiance bloom and releases its auxiliary targets. Uses two reduced-resolution passes; disable it to save GPU work.
raydiance.help.bloomThreshold: Brightness cutoff for bloom. Higher values restrict halos to brighter areas. Requires bloom; changing this threshold alone does not remove its passes.
raydiance.help.atmosphere: Sky and atmosphere intensity provided by the selected pack. Appearance depends on the pack and dimension.
raydiance.help.contactShadows: Shadow intensity. Compatible Direct Terrain integration requests native shadows; the OpenGL route uses its available implementation. Coverage varies and geometry cost may increase.
raydiance.help.water: Water effect intensity. Supported waves and refraction depend on the pack and backend. DX12 integration may activate the translucent stage and another interop round trip.
raydiance.help.reflections: Water reflections. Direct uses screen-visible data with an atmosphere approximation outside the screen. May activate translucent rendering and add GPU cost.
raydiance.help.wind: Vegetation animation for geometry and materials recognized by the backend. Compatible Direct performs deformation in DX12. 0 removes the wind request.
raydiance.help.ssao: Screen-space depth occlusion. More samples and higher resolution increase cost. Lus provides separate sample limits. 0 disables the contribution.
raydiance.help.godRays: Screen-space sunlight rays when supported by the selected pack. Depends on visible occlusion and sun position. May require multiple samples.
raydiance.help.sharpen: Enhances fine contrast. Excess may cause halos or shimmering. Does not restore lost detail; Lus limits its sharpening strength.
raydiance.help.toneMapping: Controls tonal mapping. In Lus, combine with highlight compression to preserve bright surfaces. Low cost.
raydiance.help.fogDistance: Multiplies ambient fog distance. 1 is neutral. Does not increase render distance or load extra chunks.
raydiance.help.Fog red: Red channel of custom ambient fog, from 0 to 1. Requires Custom fog color. Does not change underwater or lava fog.
raydiance.help.Fog green: Green channel of custom ambient fog. Requires Custom fog color.
raydiance.help.Fog blue: Blue channel of custom ambient fog. Equal channel values produce gray.
raydiance.help.Transition (s): Smoothing time for dynamic profile changes. 0 applies changes immediately. Does not change day length or chunk updates.
raydiance.help.Detalhe DX12: Sets the detail value supplied to terrain shaders that use it.
raydiance.help.Effects: Master switch for effects managed by Raydiance. Direct Terrain has its own independent switch in Direct settings.
raydiance.help.FXAA: Screen-space edge smoothing. May soften fine textures. Requires support in the active pack; does not reconstruct temporal detail.
raydiance.help.Quality: Budget for effects that consult this setting. Higher settings can increase samples and cost. Lus also has its own sample limits.
raydiance.help.Dynamic profiles: Selects visual rules by dimension, biome, weather and time. These rules may override base values. Disable while comparing manual settings.
raydiance.help.Edit profiles: Use dimension and biome IDs, or * for any. The highest-priority matching rule is selected; names break ties. Other rules are not combined.
raydiance.help.Custom fog color: Overrides ambient fog with the three RGB channels. Water and lava keep their dedicated fog treatment.
raydiance.help.Reload profiles: Reads the profile file from disk. Use after external edits and check the status for errors.
raydiance.help.Pack: Choose a folder pack for the Direct DX12 world pass. Choose None for standalone Raydiance visuals.
Opens controls declared by the active pack. Changes are previews until you save on the main screen.
raydiance.help.Open shaderpacks folder: Opens config/raydiance/shaderpacks. Packs must use the Raydiance format; Iris packs are not automatically compatible.
raydiance.help.Reload shaders: Requests shader reload and compilation. Check diagnostics and the log if compilation fails.
raydiance.help.Use pack defaults: Uses general values declared by the pack. Editing a general control copies defaults to manual settings. Pack-specific options remain separate.
raydiance.help.Direct DX12 integration: Enables optional geometry effects and HLSL passes through a compatible Direct API. Does not turn on Direct Terrain. Disabling releases Raydiance requests.
raydiance.help.HLSL: Additional Direct passes. none skips the extra pass but does not disable every native geometry effect. Full-screen passes may increase cost.
raydiance.help.Install HLSL example: Installs an API example. It is optional and not required by Lus.
raydiance.help.Reload DX12 pass: Refreshes the selected Direct pass. Requires compatible Direct integration.
raydiance.help.Install multi-pass exampl: Installs a development example with multiple passes. Optional and potentially more expensive.
raydiance.help.Save: Writes general settings and edited pack options. Changes are previews until saved. Errors remain on screen.
raydiance.help.Cancel: Reverts changes from this editing session. Inside a pack, only edits since opening that pack screen are reverted.
raydiance.help.materialSpecular: Sun highlights by Direct material classification. Requires compatible DX12 Terrain integration. No external PBR maps. May use a more expensive lighting variant.
raydiance.help.materialWetness: Rain darkens and glosses upward-facing skylit surfaces. Requires Direct integration. Does not simulate puddles.
raydiance.help.materialEmissive: Preserves classified emissive surface colors in darkness. Requires Direct integration. Does not light neighboring blocks or replace bloom.
raydiance.help.waterAbsorption: Water color and opacity by depth. Requires compatible Direct translucent rendering. May add depth snapshots and transfers.
raydiance.help.Direct settings: Open the Direct terrain dashboard. Direct saves separately; your pending Raydiance edits are kept.
raydiance.ui.finishDirectNavigation: Use Save or Cancel to finish this screen and return to the previous settings.
raydiance.ui.baseContext: These settings apply when no shaderpack is selected.
raydiance.ui.basePaused: %s is selected. These settings take effect when you choose None under Shaderpacks.
raydiance.ui.packContext: Choose a pack to use its settings. Packs run on Direct DX12 when it owns the world, otherwise on OpenGL.
raydiance.ui.packNeedsDirect: Direct Terrain is missing. Choose None to use standalone Raydiance effects.
raydiance.ui.editingPack: Editing %s. Changes are saved only for this pack.
raydiance.ui.directMissing: Direct Terrain is not installed. Raydiance settings are available in the first tab.
raydiance.ui.directContext: Open Direct to change the renderer and terrain budgets. Direct saves its own settings.
raydiance.ui.passContext: This optional HLSL file runs on terrain. Enable Raydiance effects and the Direct DX12 renderer to use it.
raydiance.ui.noFiles: No files available in the shaderpacks folder.
raydiance.ui.defaultsPreview: Pack defaults restored. Save to keep these changes.
raydiance.ui.hlslInstalled: Installed softwarm.hlsl in the shaderpacks folder.
raydiance.ui.packInstalled: Installed multipass_demo in the shaderpacks folder.
raydiance.help.enablePass: Allows the optional standalone HLSL pass to run through Direct.
raydiance.help.baseEffects: Enables the built-in visuals and allows the optional terrain HLSL pass to run. A selected shaderpack uses its own settings.
raydiance.configuration.Pack.tooltip: Packs run through Direct DX12. Select None for built-in effects.
raydiance.ui.ruleNameTip: Ties in priority are resolved by profile name.
raydiance.ui.dimensionTip: Use a dimension ID such as minecraft:overworld, or * for any dimension.
raydiance.ui.biomeTip: Use a biome ID such as minecraft:plains, or * for any biome.
raydiance.ui.weatherTip: Use clear, rain, thunder or * for any weather.
raydiance.ui.startTimeTip: World time in ticks from 0 to 23999. Noon is 6000.
raydiance.ui.endTimeTip: Exclusive end. Use the start time for an all-day profile.
raydiance.ui.optionValuesTip: Separate key=value pairs with commas, for example bloom=0.2,saturation=1.0.
raydiance.help.baseTab.atmosphere: Adjusts the built-in sky glow and atmospheric haze.
raydiance.help.baseTab.contactShadows: Adjusts terrain shadows and their screen-space fallback.
raydiance.help.baseTab.water: Adjusts waves and refraction on water rendered by Minecraft.
raydiance.help.baseTab.reflections: Adjusts screen-space reflections on water. The effect uses the visible scene.
raydiance.help.baseTab.wind: Adjusts how strongly supported plants and leaves sway.
raydiance.help.baseTab.ssao: Darkens nearby surfaces where they meet, using scene depth.
raydiance.help.baseTab.godRays: Adjusts rays around the sun. Nearby terrain can block them.
raydiance.help.baseTab.sharpen: Emphasizes fine image details. High values can create halos.
raydiance.help.baseTab.toneMapping: Softens bright highlights in the final image.
raydiance.help.baseTab.strength: Blends the processed image with the original. Zero removes the color pass contribution.
raydiance.help.baseTab.temperature: Warms or cools the color balance. Zero is neutral.
raydiance.help.baseTab.Quality: Sets the sampling budget for built-in effects such as shadows and ambient occlusion.
raydiance.help.baseTab.FXAA: Smooths jagged edges in the built-in final image.
raydiance.help.packTab.Quality: Sets the quality level supplied to this shaderpack.
raydiance.help.packTab.FXAA: Requests edge smoothing from this pack. The shader must support it.
raydiance.help.packTab.fogDistance: Scales the terrain fog distance requested by this shaderpack.
raydiance.help.packBackend: Automatic uses Direct DX12 when it replaces the world renderer and the pack has direct.hlsl; otherwise the pack's GLSL runs on OpenGL. The reason is shown in the status. Direct only pauses the pack without DX12; OpenGL only never uses Direct.
raydiance.help.installProgramExample: Creates iris_style_demo: a format-3 pack with composite/final programs, colortex buffers, #define options, a Nether variant and lang files. Existing folders are not overwritten.
raydiance.ui.defineRecompile: Changing this option recompiles the shaderpack.
raydiance.pipeline.directRejected: Direct DX12 rejected %s: %s. Trying OpenGL in automatic mode.
